# Integrations
{: .no_toc }

Every way to connect Substratal to other tools, in one place.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `INT-01` |
| **Route** | `/dev/integrations` |
| **Where** | Developer › Integrations |
| **Who can use it** | webhooks.manage or api_keys.manage |
| **Kind** | list |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M2 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform webhooks | list | → WHK-01 filtered to `scope: platform` | for SIEM, warehouse or chat tools |
| Agent and service keys | list | → KEY-01 filtered by `intended_use` |  |
| MCP server | instructions | `https://api.substratalapps.com/mcp` with a restricted agent key | copy button |
| Alarm destinations | list | → OPS-04 subscribers; chat delivery via AWS Chatbot | Terraform-owned: link to the variable |
| Stripe | key-value | portal links; `billing_unavailable` state |  |
| Log export | text | a CloudWatch subscription filter, configured in Terraform | documentation only |

## For developers

Loads: `GET /webhooks?scope=platform` · `GET /api-keys`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
